NSSystemAdministrationUsageDescription: SystemCleaner needs access to your files to report what is using disk space and to remove what you choose to remove.
NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: SystemCleaner scans your Desktop for large files.
NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: SystemCleaner scans your Documents for large files.
NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: SystemCleaner scans your Downloads for large files.
NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: SystemCleaner asks Finder to move items to the Trash so deletions stay recoverable.
